name: projects/5855422246659088288/screens/8b8b0f2c95cc48989fea4d652ffb3147
prompt:
Design the exact LIGHT mode Project Files workspace screen (1440x1000 desktop view) strictly adhering to Maqbool Essential design guidelines:
- Canvas background: #f7f8f7, surface: #ffffff, text: #202923, primary green: #176b50, quiet borders: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08).
- Left Sidebar (224px wide, fixed height):
  - Brand header: Maqbool with colorful geometric brand mark (interlocking square/circle geometric motif in coral/emerald/indigo/yellow).
  - Navigation items: Home (icon home), Projects (icon folder, active state with subtle indicator), My work (icon check_circle), Inbox (icon inbox).
  - Bottom navigation: Settings (icon settings) pinned at the bottom.
  - Slim 13px Inter typography, 8px rounded navigation pills, quiet hover states (140ms transition).
- Top Area / Project Navigation:
  - Project Title: 'Studio North' with subdued project indicator.
  - Project tabs: Overview, Work, Timeline, Updates, Files (ACTIVE tab with quiet primary green border/text), Delivery.
- Main Files Workspace:
  - Header line: Heading 'Files' (Inter 18px font-medium text-[#202923]).
  - Right action controls: One primary button 'Add files' (bg-[#176b50] hover:bg-[#125540] text-white text-[13px] font-medium px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-none flex items-center gap-1.5) and a quiet secondary 'More' button (outline border text-[#202923] text-[13px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-black/5 flex items-center gap-1).
  - Filter bar directly below: Single search input with search icon ('Search files...'), plus two clean select/dropdown filter pills: 'All files' (with small down chevron) and 'All locations' (with small down chevron).
  - Simple full-width compact table with 64px uniform row heights, 1px quiet separators, aligned columns:
    1. Name (with file type icon e.g. pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx)
    2. Reference (quiet monospace/clean text e.g. HR-001)
    3. Purpose (subdued quiet badge, no rainbow styling, e.g. 'Source' or 'Output')
    4. Version (e.g. v2, v1, v3)
    5. Linked work (e.g. 3 tasks, 1 task)
    6. Updated (e.g. 2 hours ago, Yesterday, Oct 12, etc.)
  - Exactly 5 rows:
    Row 1: 'briefing.pdf' | 'HR-001' | Purpose badge 'Source' | 'v2' | '3 tasks' | '2 hours ago'
    Row 2: 'welcome-guide.docx' | 'HR-002' | Purpose badge 'Output' | 'v1' | '1 task' | 'Yesterday'
    Row 3: 'budget.xlsx' | 'HR-003' | Purpose badge 'Source' | 'v3' | '2 tasks' | '3 days ago'
    Row 4: 'site-survey.pdf' (with a tiny quiet 'Shared drive' label next to or under filename) | 'HR-004' | Purpose badge 'Source' | 'v1' | '1 task' | 'Oct 14'
    Row 5: 'slide-deck.pptx' | 'HR-005' | Purpose badge 'Output' | 'v2' | '1 task' | 'Oct 10'
  - Table footer / status:
    - Subtle honest bottom line: '620 MiB of 2 GiB used' and a quiet inline link 'View storage' (hover:underline text-[12px] text-gray-500).
    - Centered/aligned quiet 'Load more' pagination button.
- Strictly NO modals, NO warning banners, NO hero cards, NO stats/metric widgets, NO marketing gradients, NO mascot, NO activity feed. Pure calm, disciplined, professional craft. 13px Inter body. 8px border radii.
title: Project Files - Light Mode

  - Left sidebar (width 224px / w-56, #ffffff or #f7f8f7) with geometric colorful brand mark and "Maqbool" wordmark, navigation items: Home, Projects (active), My work, Inbox, and Settings at the bottom.

  - Scrollable/flexible Modal Body (padding p-6 space-y-5 text-[13px] text-[#202923]):
    - Header note or column headers: A quiet table/list header for document matching (Columns: Document, Reference, Target Task, Source details).

      1. Row 1: File icon + briefing.pdf (2.4 MiB). Editable Document reference field pre-filled with "HR-001". Task name selector or input: "Update project scope".

Optional shared-drive / external notice: reveals concise external notice "Shared drive location: /Operations/Finance. External source backup advised." in muted amber note.

- Exact 13px Inter font, quiet 1px lines, 8px compact corners, calm and disciplined UI.
